hudson.model.TextParameterDefinition.name: s3_uris
hudson.model.TextParameterDefinition.description: Return delimited list of S3 uris for each dcc dataset. Make sure youre grabbing the desired version - often multiple versions are in the same root folder.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash mkdir downloads mkdir hrmn
for bucket_s3_name in ${bucket_s3_names}; do aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::${nhlbi_account_number}:role/nih-nhlbi-TopMed-EC2Access-S3 --role-session-name "get-phenotypic-data" > assume-role-output.txt export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
aws s3 cp --recursive $s3_uri downloads/ --exclude "*" --include "*.txt*" --include "*.xml*" find . -name '*.gz' -exec mv {} hrmn \; find . -name '*.gz' -exec tar -zxf {} \; -exec rm {} \; rm -f -r downloads
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN done
aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 900 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
conn_user='postgres' conn_pass=`aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id 'rds!db-8086eb77-cd6d-48bc-9298-4380892798ca' --region 'us-east-1' --query SecretString --output text | jq -r .password` database_psql_host_address='dictionarydb.cljahwnkfisu.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com' DB=hrmn
echo "creating hrmn db if none exists" PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" createdb $DB --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" -U $conn_user
echo "testing connection to new db" PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet \ --host="$database_psql_host_address" \ --port="5432" \ --username="$conn_user" \ --dbname="$DB" \ -c "\q" if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "Connection test failed!" exit 255 else echo "Connection test succeeded - conn_user=$conn_user database_psql_host_address=$database_psql_host_address DB=$DB" fi
echo "Establishing necessary schemas" PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -c "CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS eav_import" \ -c "CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS var_dd_import" \ -c "CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS util" \ -c "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS tablefunc"
ls hrmn | grep
